* WHERE...Hocking River at Athens.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Low sections of Harmony Road begin to
flood. In Nelsonville, the baseball fields along Watkins Street
flood. At 20.0 feet, Low areas, campground, and private camps along
the river between Athens and Coolville begin to flood. Much of the
city of Athens is protected up to 26 feet by levees. In
Nelsonville, the baseball field adjacent to Lake Hope Drive floods.

- At 2:15 PM EDT Tuesday the stage was 20.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 16.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 2:15 PM EDT Tuesday was 20.2 feet.

this evening and continue falling to 10.9 feet Sunday morning.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.

feet on 02/10/2019.
